name: Burn Bar
author: nixfred
description: Live thermal heat map of the AIs this machine actually uses (Claude, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and local Ollama when a GPU is present), with budget pacing per subscription, quota gauges, and the share of tokens kept off frontier models.

barWidget.description: Token spend as a heat map. Lanes appear for the AIs this machine uses. Claude burns left, Codex right, Grok after Codex, and a live GPU lane only when a discrete GPU is detected.

schema.label: Minimum width (px)
schema.description: The narrowest the strip will go, and its fixed width when Fill is off. Raised automatically when the configured cells would not fit.

schema.label: Fill the room beside it (off by default)
schema.description: Grow from the minimum to take whatever space is free between this widget and the next section of the bar, the way the Now Playing deck does on the left.

schema.label: Card headline
schema.description: What each subscription card leads with: how much of the plan is spent and whether it will last, or raw tokens burned.

schema.label: Card glow
schema.description: What makes a subscription card glow: burning over pace, burning right now, how much of the budget is spent, time to stop for the day, or never.

schema.label: Suggest a subscription to use
schema.description: With two or more subscriptions, a chip on the strip names the one with the most banked budget whenever nothing is over pace. The local GPU is never suggested.

schema.label: Show 5-hour session windows
schema.description: Off by default: the weekly and monthly windows are the ones that bite.

schema.label: Max per lane (0.1 in)
schema.description: Physical width the strip may take for each visible lane (Claude, Codex, Grok, local), in tenths of an inch. 10 = 1 inch per lane. It still shrinks below this when the bar is crowded.

schema.label: Maximum width (px)
schema.description: Ceiling for the fill. Never below the minimum.

schema.label: Fill gap (px)
schema.description: Breathing room kept between the strip and the neighbour it grows towards.

schema.label: Cells per cloud agent
schema.description: Minimum cells per cloud agent. A stretched strip adds more so a wide lane stays granular instead of blocky.

schema.label: History window (minutes)
schema.description: How far back the cloud lanes reach. 360 = six hours.

schema.label: Plan-limit refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often Burn Bar asks Omarchy's own usage collectors for fresh Claude and Codex plan limits. Grok limits are read from ~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl on each collect.

schema.label: Show the local GPU lane
schema.description: Allow the local intelligence lane. It still stays hidden until a discrete GPU (NVIDIA, AMD, or Jetson) is detected on this machine or the configured Ollama box. Intel integrated graphics does not count.

schema.label: Local poll interval (ms)
schema.description: Each poll is one HTTP call, plus ssh when the Ollama box is another machine. Ignored when no GPU is detected.

schema.label: Local inference threshold (%)
schema.description: Load above this counts as actively inferencing.

schema.label: Ollama URL
schema.description: Where Ollama answers. Defaults to this machine. Set to http://nano:11434 (and localHost to nano) for a Jetson on the tailnet. Unused when no GPU is detected.

schema.label: Ollama box (ssh host)
schema.description: localhost for a GPU on this machine, or an ssh alias of another box (nano, a Jetson). Hardware telemetry and the token journal go over ssh only when the host is not this machine. Unused when no GPU is detected.

schema.label: Meter systemd unit
schema.description: The ollama-meter unit on that box whose journal carries one line per request. Local token counts and the offload share come from there.

schema.label: Follow theme colours
schema.description: Take each lane's hue from the active Omarchy theme, keeping the strip's own intensity so cells still read as embers. Off pins the built-in Claude orange / Codex teal / Grok rose / local violet on every theme.

schema.label: Ember flicker
schema.description: Live flicker on hot cells. Turn off to save a little GPU.

schema.label: Rising sparks
schema.description: Embers lifting off the strip while anything is burning.
